contracts: ADR-0001: complete standalone Boost.Regex 1.89.0 behavior and default capability; librime-rs integration remains outside this delivery.
ADR-0002: pure Rust library, permitted operating-system APIs, no C/C++ ICU at runtime; fixed ICU4C 77.1, Unicode 16.0.0, CLDR 47 and Rust stable.

ADR-0003: preserve actual results and errors, independent resource limits, Unicode/compilation workloads at most 2x Boost time and engine working memory at most 2x Boost plus 64 KiB under the agreed protocol.

ADR-0004: safe native Rust APIs; byte/UTF-8 positions in original bytes, UTF-16 positions in original 16-bit units, UTF-32 positions in original 32-bit units; half-open ranges; immutable built-in compiled rules shareable between threads.
ADR-0005: getloc queries the actual process default; imbue returns the previous actual selection; only actual empty-input IDENTICAL native-crash behavior receives the approved valid-key exception.

Source mechanisms and invariants precede implementation. Finite differential passes never prove arbitrary-string equality; no runtime input-to-reference-key table, forced NFD, locale allowlist, discarded failures or relaxed gate may substitute for missing mechanisms.
